web_meta_description: Explore iuvui components, variants, styles, and versioned Registry artifacts.
web_status: React components · public packages + workspace previews
web_summary: An ownable React component system with package distribution, source delivery, and versioned upstream provenance. Every component is free; your team chooses how much code to own.
web_components_description: Browse real exports in the current @iuvui/react workspace. Items marked Workspace preview are not yet available from npm; Registry JSON appears only for released source artifacts.
web_no_components_description: Try a component name, category, or package path.
web_not_found_description: The requested documentation page does not exist yet.
web_component_button_description: An accessible action or link with variants, sizes, radii, and pending states.
web_component_card_description: A composable content surface with stable header, title, description, action, content, and footer parts.
web_component_text_field_description: A compound field with label, input, description, error, and validation states.
web_component_dialog_description: A compound modal dialog with explicit trigger, backdrop, positioner, content, and close parts.
web_component_input_description: A native single-line input with semantic focus, invalid, and disabled styling.
web_component_label_description: A native label that pairs with form controls through standard HTML semantics.
web_component_separator_description: A semantic horizontal or vertical divider for related content.
web_component_textarea_description: A native multiline input with semantic focus, invalid, and disabled styling.
web_preview_text_field_description: We only use this address for product updates.
web_preview_card_description: A composable surface with stable content parts.

web_preview_dialog_description: This preview uses the published iuvui component contract.

web_variant_matrix_description: All free variants currently exported by @iuvui/react.
web_variant_configure_description: Select values to update the preview and code together.

web_styles_description: Import the complete free bundle or only the theme, base layer, and component styles your application needs.
